findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe YAML deserialization
 * @description Calling yaml.load() without a SafeLoader can lead to arbitrary code execution.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-yaml-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember("load").getACall()
select call, "Call to yaml.load() which may be unsafe if not using SafeLoader."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe usage of yaml.load() can lead to arbitrary code execution.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command Injection
 * @description Executing commands with untrusted input can lead to command injection.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall() and
    call.getArgByName("shell").asExpr().(ImmutableLiteral).booleanValue() = true
  ) or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential command injection."
findings.hypothesis: Potential command injection via subprocess or os.system/popen.
